name: State building norms
review_status: Reference document only. Norms and their status read in the state register of construction norms. Pending review by a Ukrainian design engineer.
references: ДБН В.1.2-14:2018 «Загальні принципи забезпечення надійності та конструктивної безпеки будівель і споруд», in force from 01.01.2019 (https://e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3199634775304307868?doc_type=2)
ДБН В.2.2-15:2019 «Житлові будинки. Основні положення», in force from 01.12.2019 (https://e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3199650971919583106)
description: Buildings in Ukraine are designed to the державні будівельні норми (ДБН). ДБН В.1.2-14:2018 sets the consequence classes CC1 to CC3 that drive the level of design review and, in the Настанова, the indicators for profit and administrative costs. ДБН В.2.2-15:2019 sets the basic requirements for residential buildings up to 73.5 metres. ДБН А.2.2-3:2014 on the content of design documentation is marked archived in the state register and is not cited as current.
practice_notes: Consequence class CC2 covers most multi-storey housing and schools
A civil protection shelter built into the building is budgeted in chapter 2 with the object it serves, together with its hermetic doors and filter ventilation
